# Words the typo audit of the published docs must not report (#546).
#
# Only developer jargon, product and project names, and text the docs show on purpose (a German BDD
# example, Turkish-letter test strings) belong here. Turkish technical derivatives that the Turkish
# dictionary does not know (kalibratoru, telemetrisinde, ...) are deliberately NOT listed: hiding them
# would hide the tool's real limitation on a jargon-dense site, so they stay in the report.
# Matching is case-insensitive and applies to the part before an apostrophe (backend'i is covered by backend).
